text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do you see now? This is what I'm made
of!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'll be rooting for you in the next race!
Don't let
me down!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know it! I'll take home first place for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Tokai Teio points two fingers

decisively up in the air.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be a Triple Crown
champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: You can do it! You got this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! I did it! I won the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm pretty great, huh? That's one
step
closer to Prez!
choice_data_list_en: That's the best outcome, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've come so far. I won't stop until I
become Triple
Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Tokai Teio's fervor, she'll make her
dream
come true for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'll be back to the grind starting
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hehe... Seems like I'm a bit tired. My
foot's
cramping.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: まずはゆっくり休もう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio shines gloriously as she
brings home
the Double Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sights are set on the final race, the
one that
will award her the title of Triple
Crown
champion—the Kikuka Sho!
